description: This file defines an 'Indenter' class responsible for managing code indentation for various file types and programming languages, including C++, JSON, and manual indentation. It includes methods for processing indentation based on file extension, code structure, and specific formatting rules.

classes.name: Indenter
classes.description: A class that handles indentation logic for different code formats and languages, including C++, JSON, and manual indentation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes indentation settings and mode flags.

methods.name: indentType
methods.description: Determines the indentation style based on the file path and extension.

methods.name: _collapseBlank
methods.description: Collapses consecutive blank lines into a single blank line.

methods.name: _indentCPP
methods.description: Applies C++ style indentation rules to a list of code lines.

methods.name: _indentJSON
methods.description: Applies JSON style indentation rules to a list of code lines.

methods.name: _indentManual
methods.description: Applies manual indentation based on special markers.

methods.name: processIndent
methods.description: Main method to process and return indented code based on current mode and settings.
